title: Density posture

domain.defaultBehavior: normal (structural density scale is a separate channel)

compatibility: additive; the three density vocabularies (contracts/tokens/schema) are recorded debt — unification is a breaking alignment owned by a future wave

normalizedStops.law: DEFAULT/NO-OP, deliberately unreceipted. 1 IS the identity of the density ramp, so a stop at 1 is the absence of a dial rather than a value of it. The distinction from shape.radius-scale's `suave`, which is unreceipted for the same arithmetic reason: `suave` was ALSO inexpressible through the DB door on two of three verticals, because the compiler elides a write of the vertical default. `normal` is fully expressible on both doors -- migrate-v1/index.ts:448 guards on `if (general.density)` and 'normal' is truthy, so appearancePostureToVariables emits --ds-density-mode-factor: 1 -- and it is still not receipted, because a receipt would certify a zero delta as evidence of a live control. Unreceipted by identity, not by inexpressibility.

calibration.nextAction: RERUN_CAUSAL_PROOF_AFTER_TREE_FREEZE. Previous receipts remain append-only historical evidence but no longer support an active claim after the canonical-path refactor.
calibration.negativeControlsScopeNote: Density scales the ROOM and the CONTROL alike, which is what separates its negative set from rhythm's. Four phrases are declared and four are deliberately NOT. DECLARED: colour and motion (density shares no channel with either), border (measured: no site composes --ds-density-effective-scale with a border width or radius), and numeric instance gaps, bound to space-modern-numeric-gap/root -- the unscaled rule at presentation/components/skin/layout-primitives.css:614 carries no multiplier, so an instance that asked for 8px still reads 8px. NOT DECLARED, and none of them is an oversight: "control height remains fixed" and "touch target remains fixed" are FALSE for this control -- Input/engines/modern/index.tsx:170 multiplies the resolved control height by --ds-density-effective-scale, and Button/engines/modern/index.tsx:279,295 scale padding-x and gap. Rhythm may claim them ("rhythm scales the room around a control, never the control"); density may not, and declaring them would assert the opposite of what the engine does. "font metrics remain fixed" and "icon size remains fixed" are true for every target this calibration measured but FALSE at control level: runtime/engines/modern/skin/menu.css:401 composes a font-size from the density scale. They are therefore narrowed to the family root rather than claimed for the control.
calibration.evidenceKindLabellingRule: Every one of the six artifacts proves BOTH a computed delta and an exact restore; each is a three-phase both-arm run. evidenceKind names the ROLE the receipt is claimed for, not the only thing its artifact contains: the three compact receipts are claimed as static-db-computed-parity and the three spacious receipts as exact-restore. A reader who wants the other half of either receipt will find it in the same artifact.

measuredResult.instrument: packages/core/scripts/check/tokens/cascade/probe (causal command), Chromium, --bundle fresh, 1280x800 dpr1, Node 22.17.0. Run AFTER H-1: the static arm composes its stop over the vertical's published BrandTheme, so it measures the theme production ships.
measuredResult.scenarios: 6 = {rottay,bithire,evnto} x {compact,spacious}, both ingress doors on ONE scene, both themes. All six self-check harness-live with zero guard failures; ingressEquivalence holds with 0 differing rows in all six; restore.exact true and negativeControls.held true on every arm of every scenario.
measuredResult.directChannel: --ds-density-mode-factor read directly on token-readout moved on BOTH arms in all six: 1 -> 0.85 at compact and 1 -> 1.15 at spacious, identical on the static and DB doors. This is the pin that matters: --ds-density-scale is emitted UNCONDITIONALLY by the compiler seed, so a non-empty lowering proves nothing about the stop. Only the mode factor does.
measuredResult.verticalBaselines: The three verticals do NOT share a baseline and the run kept them apart: --ds-density-scale reads 1 (rottay), 0.9 (bithire) and 1.125 (evnto) on the static arm, each vertical's own authored value. Before H-1 all three lowered as 1.
measuredResult.paintedDelta: gap on space-modern-preset-gap/root, identical on both arms and both themes: rottay 15px -> 12.75px (compact) and 15px -> 17.25px (spacious); bithire 13.5px -> 11.475px and 13.5px -> 15.525px; evnto 16.875px -> 14.3438px and 16.875px -> 19.4062px. The RATIO is exactly 0.85 and 1.15 on all three verticals while the absolute values differ, which is the signature of a pure multiplier over a per-vertical structural scale.
measuredResult.chain: Three hops, visible in the token-readout row (Chromium returns the specified value for an unregistered custom property, so the composition is legible verbatim): --ds-density-mode-factor -> --ds-density-global-effective-scale = clamp(0.5, calc(--ds-density-scale * --ds-density-mode-factor), 3) -> --ds-density-effective-scale -> the scaled gap rule. bithire reads calc(0.9 * 1) at baseline and calc(0.9 * 0.85) at compact.
measuredResult.rhythmIsolation: The measured gap composes density AND rhythm in one calc(). Rhythm was held at baseline and PROVEN so, not assumed: the three compiled artifacts emit zero --ds-rhythm-* declarations, so the :root seed of 1 governs, and --ds-rhythm-effective-scale was read on token-readout in both phases of every scenario.
measuredResult.negativeWitness: space-modern-numeric-gap/root did not move in any scenario: gap, column-gap and row-gap all read 8px in both phases, on both arms.
measuredResult.restoreAsymmetry: restore.exact is true on all three verticals despite an asymmetric baseline: rottay and evnto declare no --ds-density-mode-factor at all (the static removal drops a declaration that was not there before), while bithire's baseline carries an explicit 1 that comes from experience.profile, not from this control. The stylesheet-bytes restore law covers both.

unmeasuredScope: The `normal` stop has no receipt by design: 1 IS the identity of the density ramp, so a stop at 1 is the absence of a dial rather than a value of it. Unlike shape.radius-scale's `suave`, it is fully expressible through both doors (migrate-v1/index.ts:448 guards on truthiness and emits --ds-density-mode-factor: 1); it is unreceipted by identity, not by inexpressibility.

ONE FAMILY was measured, primitive/layout/space. The claim is about the channel and the two doors, not about every surface density sizes: --ds-density-effective-scale has 71 real readers, including Button, Input, Tree, TreeSelect and Skeleton, and none of them was painted here. The declared fan-out (2 channels, representativeOnly) and the phase-a ledger fanOutClass NARROW both undercount it badly.

The legacy preset spellings and the `separator` part of the Space anatomy are inventoried, not proven: this calibration declares stableParts [root] and propertyGroups [preset-and-exact-gap] and nothing wider.
Responsive divergence: the probe pins one viewport (1280x800, dpr 1), so no claim is made at another breakpoint.

knownDefects.finding: Three density vocabularies coexist and the control registry admits it (capabilities/index.ts: "the three density vocabularies (contracts/tokens/schema) are recorded debt"). Measured spread: the control enum is {compact, normal, spacious}; contracts/composition/tenants/index.ts:211 says {compact, comfortable, spacious}; themes/index.ts:657 says {compact, comfortable, normal, spacious}; DENSITY_MODE_FACTORS accepts all four with comfortable and normal both = 1; and the nested boundary selector list in foundation/base/density.css:60-62 accepts {compact, comfortable, spacious} -- without `normal`. So `comfortable` is a value isDensityPreference accepts that is NOT a stop of this control.
knownDefects.remediation: Not touched here: unifying them is a breaking alignment across three contracts, owned by a later wave. This packet measured only the declared stops.

knownDefects.finding: brand-themes/bithire/index.ts:3582-3584 justifies densityScale 0.9 as "high information density without shrinking touch targets... Component geometry below owns controls". The mechanism disagrees: Input/engines/modern/index.tsx:170 multiplies the resolved control height by --ds-density-effective-scale, which on bithire runs at 0.9. Either the comment is stale or the coarse-pointer touch floor is at risk.
knownDefects.remediation: Reported, not fixed: it is an accessibility adjudication, not a calibration edit.
